page_title: ESP 1-2 ALA | Espanyol v Alaves 30/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.

90+6' A bullet header by Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.

90+4' What a chance that is! Exposito swings the ball into the box, and Kike Garcia (Espanyol) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
90+2' Some neat passing and movement from Alaves as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is penalised for a foul. Miguel Sesma had a clear view and blows his whistle.
87' Lucas Boye (Alaves) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
87' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Lucas Boye (Alaves) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.

81' Carles Alena (Alaves) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
80' Jon Guridi (Alaves) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
79' The substitution has been made. Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) has replaced Clemens Riedel.

73' Today's match ends for Toni Martinez who will be replaced by Jon Guridi (Alaves).
71' 1 - 2 Goal! Toni Martinez manages to prod the ball to Lucas Boye (Alaves) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:2.

67' The corner from Exposito (Espanyol) is hurriedly cleared.

65' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.

64' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the right post and wastes a promising chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
64' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.

63' Yusi (Alaves) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Marko Dmitrovic pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.
62' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Calebe and he is replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).

54' Exposito (Espanyol) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Espanyol are going to take it.

52' The ratio of the ball possession is 45:55.
50' Calebe (Alaves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
48' Calebe (Alaves) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
47' Alaves are seeing far more of the ball now.
46' Half-time substitution. Eduardo Coudet decided to make a change. Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is replaced by Facundo Garces.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.

45+3' Jon Pacheco (Alaves) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic keeps it out.
45+2' Carles Alena (Alaves) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
45+2' Espanyol concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. That's a free kick to Alaves.

45' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45' The foul by Kike Garcia (Espanyol) was seen by Miguel Sesma who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick is awarded to Alaves.
43' The game is interrupted now, Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

41' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) latches onto a lofted pass from Exposito on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
41' The free kick is delivered by Exposito (Espanyol) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
40' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Espanyol out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
40' Yellow card. Victor Parada (Alaves) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
38' Lucas Boye (Alaves) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic makes a comfortable save.
37' Toni Martinez (Alaves) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
34' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
32' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes.
30' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

27' 1 - 1 Goal! Antonio Blanco (Alaves) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Marko Dmitrovic is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
27' Carles Alena (Alaves) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
26' 2:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
23' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Marko Dmitrovic makes a simple save.
21' The Espanyol players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
15' 1 - 0 Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) finds some space inside the box and scores with a terrific header low inside the left post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
15' Ball possession – 34:66.
13' The Alaves players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' Toni Martinez (Alaves) hits a shot towards the top of the net from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Marko Dmitrovic.

9' Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Miguel Sesma with no other option than to blow for a foul. Espanyol are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
9' Victor Parada (Alaves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
7' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Kike Garcia (Espanyol) inside the box.
4' Alaves string together a series of short passes.
3' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
2' Looks like Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
